GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (15 Jan 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1469)
APO 500
15 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 9 March 1946, file AG 000.5 (9 Mar 46) LS-R, (SCAPIN 807), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one HAYASHI, Tadahiko, Major, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said HAYASHI's name. This name appears as the first name on Page No. 3 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
